title.rendered: We Have the Mind of Christ: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: We have the mind of Christ. Not we are working toward it. Have. By the indwelling Spirit, the mind of the One who upholds the universe is now in residence in you.

content.rendered:
We have the mind of Christ. Not we are working toward it. Not we are reaching for it. Have. Present tense. By the indwelling Spirit, the mind of the One who upholds the universe is now in residence in you.

The Gospel For Today | Monday, June 15, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“For, ‘Who has known the mind of the Lord so as to instruct him?’ But we have the mind of Christ.”
1 Corinthians 2:16 (NIV)

Today’s Message

Paul writes 1 Corinthians 2 to a divided church in a corrupt city. Corinth was wealthy, intellectually proud, sexually permissive and spiritually confused. Into that environment, Paul makes a claim that should have stunned every Greek philosopher within hearing range. Believers in Jesus, he says, have the mind of Christ.

The Greek word he uses is nous. Not just thoughts. The entire faculty of perception, understanding, judgement, attention and remembering. The whole inner architecture that makes a person who they are. Paul claims that the same nous that belongs to Jesus now belongs to the believer through the indwelling Spirit. The same Jesus who saw through the schemes of Pharisees, who answered every trap question with a sentence, who knew the heart of the woman at the well before she opened her mouth, who calmed storms with a word, has placed His mind inside you.

This is not a slogan to feel better about ourselves. It is a working reality for the next decision you face today. The Christian life is not a mind upgrade you have to wait for. It is a mind transfer that has already happened. The work for the believer is not to acquire the mind of Christ. The work is to walk in the mind of Christ we have already been given.

That means your responses to the day are not capped by your natural intelligence. They are not limited by your education, your culture or your past. The Spirit of God indwells you, and He brings the mind of Christ into the situations you are walking into. The wisdom is available. The clarity is available. The peace under pressure is available. The discernment to see what is really happening is available. We have it. We just have to walk in it.

Today, in the next conversation that confuses you, in the next decision that overwhelms you, in the next moment when you do not know what to do, do not strain for an answer. Pause. Remember who lives in you. Ask. And then trust that the mind of Christ, present in you by the Spirit, is already at work on the very thing in front of you.

Prayer

Father, thank You that by Your Spirit I have the mind of Christ. I am not limited to my own thinking today. The clarity, wisdom, peace and discernment of Jesus are available to me right now. Quiet the noise of my own mind. Bring the mind of Christ forward in every conversation, every decision, every challenge. Let me walk through this day with the very thinking of my Saviour. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

I have the mind of Christ. The clarity, wisdom and discernment of Jesus are available to me through His Spirit. Today I walk in the mind of Christ. I am not capped by my own intelligence. I am carried by the One who upholds all things by His word.
